headline: Trump rolls out red carpet for Putin

beats.text: Number one. Four days before his summit with Vladimir Putin, the President told reporters exactly where he was headed.

beats.caption: It's going to be a big thing. We're going to Russia. That's going to be a big deal.
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: The summit was in Alaska. Which America bought from Russia in eighteen sixty-seven. Close enough, apparently.

beats.caption: A lot of European leaders, but they rely on me, very much rely on me.
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: And what happens to the war without him?

beats.caption: If it wasn't for me, this thing would never get solved until the last person breathing is dead.
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: Then Putin landed, and Trump rolled out a literal red carpet, clapping as he walked in. Military jets flew overhead, just for the photo.

beats.caption: President Putin, will you agree to a ceasefire? Mr. President, what's your message to Vladimir Putin?
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Russia's foreign ministry said the red carpet showed Russia was no longer isolated. The summit ended with no deal on Ukraine. But the carpet looked great.
